title: Never again
text:
Never again. Bait and switch. Sent shelves only then claimed they don't have the baskets that were to be included and offered a measly discount. I will not purchase another item from this seller.
It is a cheap set of shelves. Easy enough to assemble but not sturdy enough to be taken apart and reassembled without some damage. It is also too shallow for the baskets that are sold separately.
